publication.title: Evidence of large-sized ankylopollexian dinosaurs (Ornithischia: Iguanodontia) in the Upper Jurassic of Portugal
authors: B. Camilo, F. Bertozzo, E. Malafaia, O. Mateus, P. Mocho, F. Ortega, M. Moreno-Azanza

locality.name: PBDB collection 49263: Praia do Caniçal, 1 km south of the type locality for Draconyx (Vale de Frades)

age.basis: PBDB assigns collection 49263 to Late Kimmeridgian–Early Tithonian with numeric bounds 152.21–145.06 Ma.
age.notes: Database-derived occurrence snapshot from Paleobiology Database reference 94125; not yet re-verified against the publication full text.

claims.summary: PBDB occurrence 489360 records Ankylopollexia in collection 49263, linked by PBDB to reference 94125.
PBDB stores the original/identified name as Ankylopollexia indet. and the accepted name as Ankylopollexia.
